title: Yadanicca16,17,
text: 3 Rūpā bhikkhave anattā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso hamasmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7 Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || 8 Dhammā anattā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso hamasmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
